name: nginz-monorepo
description: NginZ Cloud-Native API Gateway Platform Monorepo

scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace=@nginz/config && npm run build --workspace=@nginz/tracing && npm run build --workspace=@nginz/logger && npm run build --workspace=@nginz/metrics && npm run build --workspace=@nginz/redis && npm run build --workspace=@nginz/rabbitmq && npm run build --workspace=@nginz/middleware
scripts.build:services: npm run build --workspace=@nginz/auth-service && npm run build --workspace=@nginz/user-service && npm run build --workspace=@nginz/product-service && npm run build --workspace=@nginz/order-service && npm run build --workspace=@nginz/payment-service
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=gateway && npm run build:services && npm run build --workspace=@nginz/frontend
